claims.statement: On bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain (input T=[x]P0, x uniform in [0,r), no auxiliary powers), the algorithm in this package recovers and verifies x by [x]G=T with probability at least 0.39, using at most 2^126.266 native-equivalent work units at C=2000. Step: h = twist_index_production(x) = argmin over x, beta*x, beta^2*x from the low 448-bit window of x*floor(2^448 beta/p) (12 partial products, i+j in {5,6}) plus the 3-product reciprocal and the mod-2^128 complement; K=min(y,p-y); m=cell(K,R,p)=(K*R)>>(bitlen(p)-1); S<-S+Tab[2h+b][m]; (a,c) <- (a+r[h][m], c+s[h][m]); then, on the same step, a two-step-return escape: if the successor class equals the class of the previous step, apply the alternate orbit row Tab[(m+1) mod R][2h+b] for that one step and continue, never aborting. Cost: 167 itemised instructions on one reference addition, log2 W 126.26594263, claim 126.266, kappa product 1.099949635 <= 2^(claim-log2 S0) 1.099993376, gate 126.274. v20h resolves the four arithmetic contradictions of rejected v20g c0fd82f9 at their source: (A) the equivariance fixture runs 1500 states x 6 = 9000 comparisons (not 12,000) with 0 mismatches and a control that mismatches on 0 of them; (B) R_eff = selector.reachable_columns(2^20,p) = 852105 (not 524,289), so the trap channel is 1/(6*R_eff) = 1.9559e-07 = 2^--22.29 per step; (C) d=11 emits 22.01 records/trial = 11.64 in-budget + 10.37 drain, i.e. 0.182 restarts per walker (not 0.344) and 11.64 per trial; (D) N=(r-1)/6 has log2 252.27 so sqrt(N) = 2^126.14 in class units (not 2^187.5), and every quantity in the note is stated in class units. The note is GENERATED by scripts/gen_v20h.py from evidence/*.json and ledger.py and re-audited by scripts/selfaudit.py, which re-derives every four-significant-figure number by an independent path and fails on orphans (planted-typo control shown to fail). Unexercised paths are now executed: twist_index_production agrees with the exact argmin on 4000 of 4000 random x with 0 near-ties, and a mutated complement disagrees on 358 of 1000; K_ESC=3 is ENFORCED inside qwalk.step (the walk raises when a lane would exceed it), re-run over 2400 trials / 392 escape fires with longest run 1 and no trip; the three-cycle channel f(z)=lambda(z+v) is censused with its no-escape control -- 0 structural three-cycles in 8388608 lane-steps, and the column-equal variant is charged in the ledger at 1/R_eff^2 = 2^--39.40, while unequal-column cycles are bounded structurally by walk^2/N = 2^-132.27 per walk. Pair-state coverage 0.3920/0.3939/0.3926 is reported with its own Clopper-Pearson bound (d=5: 0.3894, below 0.39) and is NOT the gate statistic; the gate is the class-level merge CP-95 0.4109/0.3977/0.3927, and recovery is class-keyed, measured at 7644 of 7644 groups converting with a mutation converting 0. Scope: a mechanistic census at a 2^29.07 class universe with the production algebra, selector, reporting rule, priced pool and priced escape, a trap fixture at 2^25.4 classes, a C fixture at 2^26.00 classes with one full 2^20-step spacing, and a production-selector probe on the real prime; the instruction count is analytic and this is not a production-size execution.
